prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: First of three camera concept frames for a real-time 3D desktop wallpaper, widescreen 16:9, single full-frame image.
Primary request: Reimagine an oriental celestial palace as a surreal monumental dreamscape named "Inverted Moon Palace". This is camera 1, the establishing panorama. Refined cinematic surrealism with believable materials and atmospheric depth, like a beautifully art-directed high-end 3D environment.
Scene: A colossal incomplete circular moon gate made of pale ivory stone floats upright above a deep teal mirror ocean hidden among softly rolling clouds. The circular gate has separated arch segments and a few levitating stone fragments, with a thin warm-gold inner edge. Inside the gate's lower half sits ONE exquisitely proportioned dark teal-roof Chinese celestial pavilion with warm windows, atop an irregular floating limestone island. A narrow gently curving ivory stair-bridge leads from the lower foreground towards the island, with gaps and a handful of hovering steps. A gigantic pearl moon appears high behind the gate, slightly offset. Two very slender waterfalls rise upwards from the ocean towards the island, dissolving into vapor. Small distant floating rock slivers give depth.
Composition: wide 35mm cinematic vista, main moon gate and pavilion in center-right, bridge entering lower-left, generous quiet atmospheric space on upper-left suitable for desktop icons. Clear foreground, middle ground, background. Camera sees across the water from a slightly elevated approach. The ring is the dominant sculptural silhouette; the palace is a small jewel that establishes immense scale.
Lighting and palette: fixed midnight teal / blue slate / pearl white / restrained champagne gold, soft moon backlight, cool mist, warm window accents, delicate bloom, physically grounded highlights and deep soft shadows. Fine aged ivory stone, water reflections, distinct roof tiles.
Constraints: architecturally coherent single environment that can be reconstructed in Three.js; stylized realism, elegant and restrained; no people, no UI, no letters, no labels, no collage, no watermark. Avoid toy diorama look, simple conical rocks, repeated pagoda islands, excessive glowing particles, overexposure.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Camera 2 concept frame, widescreen 16:9, one full-frame image.
Input image role: the attached image is the approved world-design reference, not a background to crop. Render a new camera angle within the same coherent environment.
Primary request: The SAME surreal Inverted Moon Palace, now from a low eye-level camera ON the floating ivory stair-bridge, looking towards the palace entrance. Preserve the incomplete giant carved ivory moon-ring, dark teal Chinese palace roofs, immense pearl moon, jagged limestone island, mirrored teal ocean and cloud sea, same blue-slate/teal/pearl/champagne-gold palette.
Composition: 28mm moderately wide lens, stone steps fill the lower foreground and lead in a graceful curve to the illuminated pavilion doorway in upper middle. Separated hovering stair slabs, tiny gilded edge rails and small warm stone lanterns give scale. The colossal incomplete ring curves overhead and is partly cropped by the frame; the moon is partly occluded by it. A few bonsai pine silhouettes grow from the island's side. Through gaps in the bridge, show the distant ocean and soft clouds far below. Elegant negative space at sides, cinematic depth.
Lighting/material: moon backlight outlines roof tiles, warm doorway glows softly on aged ivory stair surfaces, believable contact shadow and fine stone weathering, restrained bloom. Serious refined surreal architectural visualization.
Constraints: this must be a distinct close approach view of the SAME place, not a second different palace or a crop of the reference. No people, no labels, no lettering, no UI, no collage, no watermark. No toy geometry or overly busy particles.

Use case: stylized-concept

Primary request: Show the SAME Inverted Moon Palace from a spectacular low camera just above the dark teal mirror ocean, looking obliquely UP towards the underside of its floating limestone island. Make impossible gravity the focus.
Composition: low 24mm cinematic lens, rippling dark mirror water across the lower quarter; the jagged hanging island occupies upper center-right. On top is the same small warm-lit Chinese pavilion with dark teal roofs, backed by the same monumental fragmented ivory circular gate and huge pearl moon. Beneath the island, a much smaller upside-down pavilion hangs like an architectural stalactite, gold-lit windows pointing towards the water. Two narrow silver streams of water RISE from circular ripples in the ocean to the island's sides, appearing as luminous ascending filaments and fine drifting spray. The narrow floating stair-bridge crosses diagonally overhead from the left. Distant limestone needles and rolling white cloud banks establish enormous depth.
Style and lighting: refined surreal architectural realism, believable aged stone, soft moonlit cloud volume, deep blue-slate and teal, ivory highlights and champagne-gold accents, restrained bloom, beautiful shadow detail, no fisheye distortion. Quiet dreamlike immense scale.
Constraints: same ring/palace/bridge design and palette as reference; this is an underside view, very different from the panorama and bridge approach. No people, no UI, no letters, no diagrams, no collage, no watermark, no toy islands or excessive particles.
